messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: High error rate detected for customer Pegasus (acct: PEG-4381) on /v1/generate (us-east-1). 5xx spike > 40% over last 5m, auto-ingest of incidents triggered :rotating_light:
alex.g: paging oncall — @jordan.oncall you're up for infra, can you take?
maria.cs: tagging CS — Pegasus CSM is Priya (priya@pegasus.ai). They have a standing SLO contract; need tailored comms.
jordan.oncall: I'm on it. pulling logs now, will report back in 2 mins.
devin.sre: FYI seeing increased queue depth on gpu-pool-3, OOMs and accept-rate drops. Possibly batch scheduling regression after recent kernel bump.
jordan.oncall: confirm, tail logs show repeated "kv cache allocation failed" on node gpu-3-17. rolling a health-check to isolate.
sam.ops: starting immediate mitigation — draining gpu-3-17 from serving pool and shifting traffic to gpu-3-9/12. patch rollout command: `infractl drain node gpu-3-17 --grace 30s`
alex.g: @pegasus-support please patch status page and prepare an initial outbound to Pegasus saying we're investigating degraded API errors in us-east-1; customers may see increased latency and 500 responses. Include ETA of 30m for mitigation.
pegasus-support: noted. Drafting message for Pegasus CSM/Support channel, will paste for approval.
maria.cs: copy of impacted surface for Pegasus: 
- /v1/generate (text gen) — increased 5xx and latencies
- /v1/embeddings — intermittent failures for long sequences
- No evidence of data exposure, just availability impact
Please include account-specific rate limits we temporarily applied: PEG-4381 capped to 50rps.
jordan.oncall: draining completed for gpu-3-17, restarted model workers on gpu-3-9 and 3-12 with older kernel (rollback). Observability shows accept-rate recovering to ~85%.
devin.sre: adding a canary config to route 20% of Pegasus traffic to dedicated fallback model variant (smaller tokenizer config) to reduce memory pressure. Command: ```routingctl set-policy acct:PEG-4381 fallback=pegasus-fallback-v1 weight=20%```
alex.g: Good. We need customer-facing messaging that is precise and minimizes alarm. Maria can you approve the notify and status text? Also we should send internal targeted comms to Sales/Account team with contact routing + impact statement.
maria.cs: Draft below — please review: 
--- STATUS PAGE UPDATE (short) ---
We are investigating increased error rates and latency impacting text generation and embeddings in us-east-1. Customers may experience 500 responses and slower responses. Engineers are mitigating; we expect partial recovery within 30 minutes. No data exposure suspected.
--- PEGASUS-CUSTOMER NOTIFICATION (tailored) ---
Hi Priya/@pegasus-support,
We're investigating degraded availability for text generation and embedding requests originating from us-east-1. You may see increased 500 responses and higher latency. We've temporarily capped your rate to 50rps and routed a portion of traffic to a fallback model variant to reduce failures. We're actively rolling a kernel rollback on affected nodes; preliminary results show a return to ~85% acceptance. We'll follow up with a detailed ETA within 30 minutes and a post-incident summary.
If Pegasus needs an immediate escalation path during this incident, please call our emergency number +1-512-555-0289 and reference PEG-4381.
--- INTERNAL NOTIFY (for Sales/AM/Support) ---
Short summary: Pegasus (PEG-4381) experiencing 5xx/latency in us-east-1 for gen/emb. Actions: drained node, kernel rollback, fallback routing, rate cap. Current status: partial recovery ~85% accept rate. Next: monitor 15m, expand fallback to 40% if errors persist.
--- END DRAFT ---

alex.g: looks good. Minor tweak: change phone to the oncall escalation number for this incident. Also add "we will not perform any maintenance that affects data" line.
pegasus-support: updated message sent to Priya at 12:23 UTC, included contact routing and emergency number. Priya replied: "Thanks — we'll stand by. Do you have an ETA for full restoration?"
devin.sre: monitoring - error rate dropped from 42% -> 12% after rollback + routing change. Still seeing occasional spikes on longer sequences (>1024 tokens).
jordan.oncall: will keep oncall watch for 30m window. If errors remain above 10% for two consecutive 5m windows, plan to expand fallback to 60% and start cold-restart of rest of gpu-3 group.
maria.cs: preparing templated customer-facing status for other enterprise customers in same region. copying Pegasus-specific line about rate cap only where applicable.
alex.g: quick note on routed fallback — ensure it preserves model parity as much as possible; add a short note to customer that we may see minor output differences while on fallback. Maria add that phrase.
maria.cs: updated notify: "You may notice slight variations in generation quality while some traffic is served by a fallback model variant."
sam.ops: expanded fallback to 40% now as precaution. Applied `routingctl` update, traffic shifts visible in dashboards.
devin.sre: Errors now ~6% over last 5m. Latency back within SLO for 90% of requests. No customer escalations beyond Priya so far.
jordan.oncall: moving to monitoring-only unless we see regression. I'll handoff at 12:55 UTC to Night SRE. @devin.sre please take escalation if it flares after handoff.
alex.g: Thanks all. Two action items: 1) Maria to send final tailored post-incident note to Pegasus with timeline and mitigation actions; 2) Devin/Jordan to open RCA stub and tag relevant kernel rollout PR for review.
maria.cs: drafting post-incident template now — will include: incident timeline, root cause hypothesis (kernel memory regression), mitigation steps (drain + rollback + fallback routing), customer impact (rate-limited to 50rps, possible quality variance), and next steps (permanent rollback or patch + load test).
jordan.oncall: created RCA draft - link: https://internal.redwood/rca/PEG-4381 (placeholder)
pegasus-support: Priya acknowledged: "Appreciate the clear updates. Please include a comment if there's any action we need to take on our side." I replied: "No action required from Pegasus at this time; we will notify when/if that changes."
alex.g: final note for incident log: incident created by incident-bot at 12:20 UTC, mitigations applied by 12:34 UTC, partial recovery by 12:40 UTC, monitoring-only and handoff at 12:55 UTC. We'll schedule a 1:1 with Pegasus AM for tomorrow to review any lingering concerns.
maria.cs: sending final tailored post-incident SPF to Pegasus now; will attach full timeline and contact routing.
devin.sre: opening follow-up task to add an automated canary for kernel bump on gpupool nodes (task INF-2291).
sam.ops: closing immediate mitigation tasks and removing temporary rate caps in 2h if stable.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Status -> Monitoring. Severity downgraded to SEV-3.
alex.g: thanks team. We'll run a postmortem next week; keep notes in the RCA link.
maria.cs: posted final customer notify at 13:05 UTC. Priya responded :thumbsup:.
pegasus-support: closing thread for this incident, moving follow-ups to RCA.
